subject: planner: rewrite semi join when to predicate push down (#63436)
summary: Reviewed first-parent diff for PR #63436. Change moves the semi-join rewrite implementation into `LogicalJoin.SemiJoinRewrite()` and calls it at the end of `LogicalJoin.PredicatePushDown()` (with `SemiJoinRewriter` becoming a thin walker), plus adds a cascades `plan_tree` test. Checked EXISTS/semi-join semantics under the rewrite’s gates (non-correlated, not LeftOuterSemiJoin, no left/other conditions) and the produced plan shape (inner join + agg + projection) for correctness-sensitive areas; no Blocker/High issues found. Scanned later history up to `upstream/master` for follow-up fixes touching the modified planner files; no later fixes specific to this change were found.
